summary: Bravida Holding AB (publ) provides technical services and installations for buildings and industrial facilities in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Finland. The company offers electrics, ventilation, heating and plumbing, fire and security, cooling, sprinkler; and energy management and optimization, building automation, vehicle charging, critical power, and solar cells.It also provides technical facility management, green hub, commercial kitchen, and services and maintenance; installations, such as contracts, coordinated projects, PMO-special projects, power supply, engineering design, and data centre services. Bravida Holding AB (publ) was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
